purpose: Bind the minimum real-world resources required to close Real Economic E2E, External 3-host Testnet and the first MetaPay capped-canary revenue corridor without allowing resource presence to self-authorize production execution.

requirements.name: live_payment_provider_account
requirements.acceptance: Provider account supports real payment/capture and refund/reversal with provider-generated references/webhooks/API evidence.

requirements.name: eligible_merchant_or_operator_entity
requirements.acceptance: Exact legal/operator entity is accepted by the chosen provider for the intended capped-canary corridor.

requirements.name: settlement_account_or_wallet
requirements.acceptance: Provider-approved settlement destination exists and can be reconciled to the live transaction.

requirements.name: small_real_canary_notional
requirements.acceptance: A deliberately small real amount is authorized for one bounded live canary; size does not substitute for external reality.

requirements.name: public_https_webhook_endpoint
requirements.acceptance: Public HTTPS endpoint can receive authenticated provider events and retain immutable evidence references.

requirements.name: three_distinct_persistent_external_hosts
requirements.acceptance: Exactly three distinct persistent external hosts exist with durable storage, unique host fingerprints, restart recovery and non-loopback cross-host transport.

requirements.name: safe_execution_access_path
requirements.acceptance: Operator-controlled connector or bootstrap execution path exists. Raw API keys, wallet private keys and SSH private keys are never pasted into chat or committed to Git.
